question: Which organization has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with **Birla Institute of Technology (BIT) Mesra** to strengthen advanced **geospatial research** and innovation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Birla Institute of Technology (BIT) Mesra** has signed a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with the **North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC)** to foster collaboration in **geospatial research**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The collaboration between **BIT Mesra** and **NESAC** aims to deepen academic and research engagement in specialized fields.
 
• Key domains identified for this partnership include **GeoAI**, **remote sensing**, **GIS**, **space technology**, and **interdisciplinary geospatial applications**.
 
• The partnership is designed to establish a robust platform for **collaborative research**, **technological innovation**, and **academic exchange**.
 
• **NESAC** operates under the **Department of Space**, Government of India. Hence, it is the specific organization mentioned in the agreement for these geospatial initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC)** is a joint initiative of the **Department of Space** and the **North Eastern Council** to support development through space science.
 
• The initiative also focuses on providing **higher education opportunities** specifically in the field of **geospatial sciences**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The primary goal of the MoU is the **strengthening of advanced research** in emerging space-related technologies.
 
• It emphasizes the use of **GeoAI** and **GIS** as critical tools for modern innovation.
